positions.title: Math Teacher
positions.description:
Taught testing grade levels and supported DC-PARCC assessment preparation, ensuring student readiness for standardized testing requirements
Utilized innovative teaching methods, including hands-on activities and technology integration, to enhance student engagement and understanding
Monitored student progress through regular assessments and adjusted instructional strategies accordingly
Implemented effective classroom management techniques to create a positive learning environment conducive to academic success

positions.title: Math Program Manager, Teacher
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Facilitated biweekly professional development workshops focused on data analysis tools and assessment strategies for grade teams
Managed and analyzed classroom performance data across multiple grade levels, achieving up to 35% growth through data-driven instructional strategies
Led weekly data review meetings focused on student assessment results and collaborative action planning
Provided instructional coaching and support to teachers in testing grade levels (3-5), helping them prepare students for New York State assessments
